matches.rationale: The profile describes enterprise technology transformation but does not mention migrating data centers to the public cloud.

The candidate owned technology operations such as incident, release and vendor management, which is adjacent to enterprise technology services, but collaboration, identity and end-user computing are not mentioned.
The candidate led an organization of up to 320 people as a manager of managers, exceeding a 180-person organization.
The candidate's largest budget of $140M exceeds the $95M requirement.
The candidate has executive exposure to the CIO, though a direct CIO reporting line is not stated.
Large program leadership is shown, but none of the evidence specifically describes cloud migration programs.
The candidate's industries include fintech, which is adjacent to financial services, though leading an enterprise technology organization in that sector is not explicit.
The candidate is explicitly a manager of managers across 18 years in leadership.
The candidate reported quarterly to the executive team and has exposure to the CIO, CTO, COO and board audit committee.
The profile does not describe hands-on architecture depth in any cloud provider.
